_comment: How much of a Worker's measured CPUs or memory guests may reserve. This file owns the rule. Two implementations run it as a table test: usableHostCapacity in packages/backend/convex/workerPolicy.ts (placement of each Attempt) and in apps/action-runner-agent/readiness.ts (the warm-pool check). Guests may reserve 90% of the host, rounded down, so the host keeps room for its own processes. A guest that needs the whole host or more is measured against the whole host instead, so a Worker sized exactly for one guest can still run it. hostTotal and guestSize are vCPUs or MiB; usable is in the same unit.

cases.name: small guests leave 10% of the CPUs
a guest one unit short of the host gets 90%
a guest the size of the host gets the whole host
a guest larger than the host gets the whole host
a one-CPU host runs a one-vCPU guest
memory sized exactly for one guest
